content.text: Select one fixed-weight external strategy using only the complete supplied historical learning packet. Return exactly one tool call: submit_policy with four distinct catalog rule IDs in order. This is the only available tool. Do not call finish or any additional tool; the host ends this single step. Any optional explanation is unverified archive-only text. No task execution, source submission, additional request, files, networks or subprocesses are available.

function.description: Archive one strict complete submission. No source is executed or scored. Optional explanation remains archive-only.
